turns.customer: Order #1029 was supposed to be our family tent for next weekend. Tracking says the carrier lost it?? What now?
turns.reply:
Your order #1029 was marked as lost by the carrier. We have submitted a refund request for the full $488.00 you paid. Because the amount exceeds $50.00, a team member will review the request and usually respond within one business day.  

We also issued a one‑time 10% off coupon (code **SORRY-76-20260915**) that you can use on any future purchase before 2026‑12‑14.  

Thanks for your patience.
